text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus began Air Messiah's life with the crab
brought back from the mountain stream—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew, finally clean...
Even for such a tiny creature,
the tank gets quite dirty, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Keeping a living creature is
far harder than I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. I'll care for you responsibly,
so please enjoy life in your mossarium.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Is this food not to your liking?
Fufufu, you're quite the gourmet, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let me consult with the shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mes-chan senpa~i.
Let's go eat cake after school~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Sure. But before that, would you mind
stopping by the aquarium shop with me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For the crab? ...Wait, didn't you
just go buy food for it the other day?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, but I'd like to ask about other types of food...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, also, would it be alright if we parted ways on the way back?
A book on crabs I ordered at the bookstore has arrived, and I'd like to pick it up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped then! Well, in that case, I'll go hop between some sweets shops too, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —chan Senpai! Mess-chan Senpai, hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Y-Yes. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Geez, come on~~!! Mess-chan Senpai, aren't you fussing way too much over that crab lately?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so?
...—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (A larger aquarium tank than before, and a mountain of care books. And—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Due to their anatomy, crabs generally walk sideways, but apparently there are species capable of walking forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Crabs live surprisingly long lives, you know. In particular, the Japanese spider crab is said to live up to 100 years.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It truly has become all about crabs, hasn't it? I'm sorry, Vivlos-san...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Weeell, it's super like you though! That earnest, super serious side of yours, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, upon returning from an outing, I happened to see Air Messiah looking distressed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san...
Excuse me...
choice_data_list: Wait, you don't look well. What's wrong?
Wait, you look pale. What happened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When asked, she explained that the crab she caught the other day seemed unwell, so she was heading to a specialty shop to consult an expert.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I made sure to observe its condition without fail and never neglected tank maintenance, or so I thought...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Surely I must have overlooked something. If only I had been more attentive, this wouldn't have...
choice_data_list: Caring for living creatures is tough...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Even so, still... Please excuse me, I must be going.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As its keeper, I must do everything within my power.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Mess-chan Senpai, haven't you barely been resting lately?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'll keep an eye on the crab, so you really should get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...
Still, this is something I want to handle myself.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Muuu~! I really think it's okay to lean on someone at times like this, though~?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Vivlos-san... It's just that I want to do this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Just like Mother did for me back then, I want to stay by its side—

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Ugh... It hurts, it's so painful... Help, me...)

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: It's alright, you'll be alright, Messiah. I'll be right by your side the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mo... ther... Okay...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Back then, when Mother stayed by my side all through the night, how happy... and how reassuring it felt.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I want to be just like Mother was on that day. That is what I decided.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I won't say another word.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Mess-chan Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Zzz, zzz...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Looks like she really reached her limit. Ah, the crab is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it's super energetic♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Having Mess-chan Senpai devote herself to you this much, you really are one lucky little guy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Air Messiah's deep affection, the crab successfully overcame its crisis.
